The nap will probably get skipped. The day can still go fine.

One missed nap really does make toddlers crankier that afternoon. It doesn't do lasting harm.
Bring home's sleep cues: the same sleep sack, white noise and bedtime books.
Babies sleep on their backs in a play yard or portable crib, never on a couch or guest bed.
And pick your leave-by time before you walk in the door.
